question:
Choose the option which is antonym of (opposite of) the word "abase" in the sentence given below:

She couldn't help but smile when he gave her a sincere compliment on her artwork.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"abase"** means to degrade or humiliate someone; to lower in rank, office, prestige, or esteem. (अपमानित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He** abased **himself in front of his superiors to gain their favor.
 
 
 
• **"Compliment"** refers to an expression of praise, commendation, or admiration. (प्रशंसा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She couldn't help but smile when he gave her a sincere **compliment **on her artwork.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'abase'** is **'compliment'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Smile** (मुस्कान): A facial expression characterized by an upward curving of the corners of the mouth, usually showing pleasure or amusement.

 
 
• **Example:** Her smile brightens up the room.
 
 
 
• **Help** (मदद): To assist or aid someone in doing something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was always ready to help her friends in need.
 
 
 
• **Sincere** (ईमानदार): Free from pretense or deceit; genuine.
 
 
• **Example:** His sincere apology was accepted by everyone.
